name: OCR
description: Reads the text in an image file, such as a photo or scan of a page, with Tesseract on this computer. Downloads only the language a read needs, the first time. Needs Python and Tesseract 4 or 5 installed. Use when the user gives an image and wants the text in it.

files.info: Reads the image file it is given, and keeps downloaded language data in its own folder

programs.info: Runs Tesseract to read the image

network.info: Downloads the language data you ask for from the official tessdata_fast repository, once

TESSERACT_PATH.info: Where tesseract is, when it is not on PATH or in the usual install folder

functions.name: ocr_read
functions.description: Reads the text in an image file (png, jpg, tif, bmp, gif, webp, pnm), such as a photo or scan of a page. A language used for the first time is downloaded automatically (only that language, a pinned file of 0.5 to 5.3 MB); pass timeout 120 then. Returns the text exactly as Tesseract read it.

path.description: The image file: a full path, or a path in the workspace

languages.description: Language codes joined with +, such as eng or eng+hin. Default eng

psm.description: Optional Tesseract page layout mode, 3 to 13. 6 is one block of text, 7 one line, 11 scattered text

timeout.description: Seconds the Engine waits. Use 120 when a language is used for the first time; the default is 30

functions.name: ocr_languages
functions.description: Lists the languages OCR can read and which are downloaded, downloads the ones named ahead of time, or removes them. ocr_read downloads a missing language by itself.

languages.description: For download and remove: codes joined with +, such as eng+hin

timeout.description: Seconds the Engine waits. Use 120 for a download; the default is 30

1.0.1.changelog: ocr_read downloads the missing language it needs, and only that one
